title: Applying for Social Security survivor benefits
facts: Social Security survivor benefits are not automatically converted in every situation simply because SSA learns of a death.
Eligible spouses, divorced spouses, children and certain dependent parents may qualify under different rules.
A person already receiving Social Security may need SSA to determine whether a survivor benefit changes the amount payable rather than receiving two full benefits added together.
Potential survivors should contact SSA promptly because application timing can affect benefits.
